race.comment: OUT ONTARIO (12) is the top pick after a more encouraging fourth at Murray Bdge, beaten two and a half lengths by Katrina's Legacy, and she now has race fitness on her side. The first try around 1200m is the obvious new element, but her latest run was a clear step back in the right direction and gives her a genuine winning chance. LITTLE ROCKET (5) brings the sharpest recent finish, having charged into second at this track behind Oasis and edged ARTFUL MAXIMUS in the process; his long maiden record is the reservation, though repeated placings keep him firmly in play. Each-way. ARTFUL MAXIMUS (1) was a well-supported favourite in that same race and closed into third despite doing a few things wrong, so he is entitled to improve second-up. KHORASAN (10) has been consistent through the campaign, was second at Strathalbyn last start, and the Kayla Crowther booking adds weight to her claims despite a modest record around 1200m. In the mix.
